The '''First Platoon''' of [[Besh Company]] in the [[Second Battalion (Fifth Infantry)|Second Battalion]] of the [[Fifth Infantry]] was a unit in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. It was stationed on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], but their attempt to upload viruses into the mainframe of the [[Okara Droid Factory]] ended in disaster when [[Droid/Legends|droids]] killed the entire platoon except [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Rutau]].
